answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 7797 Country: India Title: Assalamualaikum mufti sahab , Khairiat ? Im sufferening from knee pain for the last 8 years .., Lately I had full check up & knee operation which turn out to be failure & all the reports caem clear with no problem ..., So i consulted a Alim sahab who told me that someone did black magic ( kartab ) on my knee .., After the operation im unable to bend my leg But before the operation it use to bend but not fully ..., Is there anything like duwaa or waazifa for me to get rid of this problem , I have had this for the last 8 years & now the leg isnt bending which means i cannot do even small chore swhich i used to do . Shukriya in advance & hoping for for a reply from you soon. Question: Assalamualaikum mufti sahab , Khairiat ? Im sufferening from knee pain for the last 8 years .., Lately I had full check up & knee operation which turn out to be failure & all the reports caem clear with no problem ..., So i consulted a Alim sahab who told me that someone did black magic ( kartab ) on my knee .., After the operation im unable to bend my leg But before the operation it use to bend but not fully ..., Is there anything like duwaa or waazifa for me to get rid of this problem , I have had this for the last 8 years & now the leg isnt bending which means i cannot do even small chore swhich i used to do . Shukriya in advance & hoping for for a reply from you soon. Answer ID: 7797 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1838/264=B/1429) You should recite Surah Al-Nas 111 times with 11 times durood before and after, sit with a tub containing clear water. After reciting, blow on a knife and then pray to Allah to remove it whether it is an evil effect, magic or disease, then cut the water with knife making x mark, and store a half bottle of the water and drink it daily for a week, have a bath with the left water adding some more water in the same day. You should do so again after a week. Possibly, it may benefit you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
